component.name: GlobeCraft
component.summary: Explore the Earth in a 3D globe

description.p: Explore satellite imagery, street maps and topography on a 3D globe. Search places, organize KML markers, measure distances and view aircraft, AIS ships, precipitation, traffic and predicted satellite positions.
The CPU globe renderer is the default. GPU globe rendering is optional and experimental.

screenshot.caption: The globe with cloud imagery and navigation controls
